stem: A technician finishes work in a room with a known pest issue and is next assigned to a clean propagation area. What is the best approach?
choices: Move directly to propagation to avoid losing time
Follow the facility's decontamination/tool-change procedure before entering the cleaner area
Carry the same tools but wipe only the handles
Visit the propagation area first only if the pest issue looks severe
rationale: People, tools and clothing can move pests or pathogens. Controlled movement and decontamination reduce cross-contamination between higher-risk and cleaner areas.
